text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite putting all her effort into 
middle-distance training, Daiichi Ruby's 
growth hits a plateau. The Trainer begins 
to consider that her true aptitude might 
lie in sprint races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Daiichi Ruby also sensed her 
own aptitudes. Even so, to avenge her 
mother, skipping the Oaks was simply out 
of the question.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Walk the royal road, become worthy of the 
clan's name, and repay the debt of being 
granted a body fit to run. To make up for 
what she lacked, she headed out to train 
on her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, KS Miracle paid a visit. 
Empathizing with Daiichi Ruby's efforts 
for what was precious to her, she prayed 
that Ruby's wish would come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby states that what she 
possesses is not a mere wish, but an 
unyielding will. Days of trial and error 
continue leading up to the Yushun Himba 
(Japanese Oaks).
